serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `ruff` executable. Leave empty to look it up on PATH.

configuration.title: Configuration File
configuration.description: Path to a `ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` file to use instead of the one discovered next to the source. Leave empty for the usual discovery.

lineLength.title: Line Length
lineLength.description: Line length used by the linter and the formatter. Leave at 0 to use the value from the Ruff configuration file.

select.title: Rule Selection: Select
select.description: Rule codes to enable, or `ALL` to enable every rule. Leave empty to use Ruff configuration files.

ignore.title: Rule Selection: Ignore
ignore.description: Rule codes to disable. Leave empty to use Ruff configuration files.

fixable.title: Rule Selection: Fixable
fixable.description: Rule codes to treat as eligible for autofix. Leave empty to use Ruff configuration files.

unfixable.title: Rule Selection: Unfixable
unfixable.description: Rule codes to treat as ineligible for autofix. Leave empty to use Ruff configuration files.

useNoqa.title: Use noqa Flag
useNoqa.description: Honor `# noqa` and file-level noqa comments when reporting diagnostics.

allowMagic.title: Allow Magic Commands
allowMagic.description: Bypass IPython magic and introspection commands, and recognize `_`, `__`, and `___` as defined names.

fixAll.title: Fix All
fixAll.description: Offer a fix-all code action that resolves every fixable violation in the document.

organizeImports.title: Organize Imports
organizeImports.description: Offer an organize-imports code action driven by Ruff's isort rules.

showSyntaxErrors.title: Show Syntax Errors
showSyntaxErrors.description: Report Python syntax errors found while parsing as diagnostics.

disableRuleComment.title: Disable Rule Comment Action
disableRuleComment.description: Offer a code action that appends a `# noqa` comment silencing the violation.

fixViolation.title: Fix Violation Action
fixViolation.description: Offer a code action that applies the autofix of a single violation.
